plain.text: Pharisees and Sadducees asked Jesus for a sign from heaven. He said they could read the weather but not the signs of the times, and the only sign would be the sign of Jonah. Later he warned his disciples to beware the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees. At first they thought he meant bread, but then they understood he meant their teaching.

At Caesarea Philippi Jesus asked, Who do people say the Son of Man is? Some said John the Baptist, Elijah, or one of the prophets. But who do you say I am? Simon Peter answered, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God. Jesus said this was revealed to him by the Father. You are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it. He gave him the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and told the disciples not to tell anyone yet that he was the Christ.

From then on Jesus began to explain that he must go to Jerusalem, suffer, be killed and be raised on the third day. Peter took him aside and protested. Jesus told him, Get behind me, Satan! You are thinking like people, not like God. Whoever wants to follow me must deny themselves, take up their cross and follow me. Whoever loses their life for me will find it. What good is it to gain the whole world but lose your soul?

summary.bigIdea: Peter declares that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus reveals that the Christ must suffer, and his followers must take up their cross.
points: Peter says Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Jesus says he will build his church.
Following Jesus means denying yourself and taking up your cross.
summary.reflection: Jesus asks, who do you say I am? What is your honest answer today?
